text: Create islands of silence in your day. It is not necessary to sit in meditation for hours. Find literally a few minutes to simply sit in silence, without a phone, music, or books. Such minutes regularly appear at moments when energy flows switch. You only need to notice them and use them. In this case you will not need to struggle with internal dialogues in attempts to perform meditation. Everything is simpler—you find yourself in silence, as if you have returned home. The information noise subsides, and your meditation will be deep and effective.
